what_happened.line: The Finance Committee heard FY23 budget presentations from the Council on Aging, the Library and the Land Use departments; no vote was taken except to adjourn.
The Library presented its request, which differs from the town manager's preliminary figure mainly on technology and utilities, plus two part-time assistants to open on Fridays.
The Planning Board asked for more money to be added to a remaining FY20 capital balance for the master plan, after the project drew zero bids.
The chair is to ask the town manager for line-item detail by department before next week, and members will route questions through the town manager.
Approval of prior minutes was deferred a week, and the meeting adjourned by roll call.

why_it_matters: These requests feed the FY23 town budget, mostly paid from taxes, and the committee has not yet seen line-item detail for several departments.
The master plan capital request would add to money already approved in an earlier year, so residents may be asked to vote on topping it up at town meeting.
watch_next: Line-item detail by department from the town manager, requested before the next weekly meeting.
IT discussion set for March 17, and a Board of Health visit likely March 24.
